verdict.rationale: Synthesia is an AI video SaaS that processes user uploads, scripts and likenesses, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes an opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or any data-use control for model training. The only nearby item is the consent and safety controls on voice cloning (docs-26), which is an adjacent control and earns no credit here.
